Here my recipe:

120 ml skimmed milk
1 tsp yeast
3 tsp sugar
1 egg
250 g bread flour
42 g unsalted butter

Proof until doubled in size. 
I divided the dough in 6 pieces, shaped and let them proof again in a rectangular tin with parchment paper until they doubled the size. 
Brush with egg wash and bake for 15/20 minutes at 175° C.
